links.comparator_used: Base ChatGPT, DeepSeek and Gemini without the PancreaGuide framework (which bundles structured prompting, RAG and a pancreatic surgery knowledge base), so the effect of retrieval alone is not isolated
links.outcome: CT report-based interpretation of resectability-related information (accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, ROC, DCA) and expert-rated perioperative consultation quality (accuracy, completeness, consistency, safety, robustness)
links.effect: Higher classification point estimates across all 3 backbones; Gemini+ accuracy 87.4% (95% CI 0.840-0.902), sensitivity 95.9% (95% CI 0.927-0.978); consultation overall scores Gemini+ mean 3.88 (SD 0.38), ChatGPT+ 3.8 (SD 10.36), DeepSeek+ 3.75 (SD 0.35); largest gains in completeness and robustness. Base-model values are not given in the abstract.
links.quote: Higher classification metric point estimates were observed after integration of the PancreaGuide framework across all 3 backbone models.

design_hint: retrieval-augmented generation and structured prompting integration
